text:
maya: Quick sync: proposing a multi-quarter program to "surface-curate" transform-related endpoints so we can shrink the hotpath and remove cross-cutting telemetry sprawl. Goal: smaller service contracts, clearer ownership, and a 6-month paydown window for tech debt.
igor: +1. Need clarity on which signals are "telemetry splice" vs business events. We should separate debug traces from billing events.
lina: For KV cache ownership I'd like a pattern: 1) designate temporary owner during migration, 2) provide cache-read hint API, 3) later flip canonical ownership with a migration job. Avoid double writes.
maya: Agreed. Proposal: orch owns cache for migration period; core exposes ReadHint(cache_key) returning (value, version). Orch will continue to write. After 90 days of zero fallbacks, flip ownership.
ops-bot: infra: canary cluster provisioned (2 nodes). Canary alerts wired: p95 latency, 5xx, semantic-diff-rate.
igor: Safety hedges: per-tenant SLAs, token-cost delta surfaced as an event, and an opt-out flag for customers mid-ramp.
product-bot: Product: we'll add a banner in the console during ramp and attach a billing delta preview in the rollout UI.
lina: Runbook sketch:
1) enable feature-flag for tenant in staging, run smoke checks
2) enable read-mirror (100%) for 48h, run semantic diffs (tolerance policy: reordering allowed)
3) enable 2% traffic -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24h holds or until regressions cleared
4) post-cutover: safe-slab retention 30d, then prune transforms after 90d of zero fallbacks
Commands:
```bash
# mirror traffic for tenant-99
./ffctl set transform-surface tenant-99 mirror=true
# show billing delta preview
./billingctl preview tenant-99 --to=enrich-core
```
maya: Metrics for sign-off: semantic-diff-rate < 0.05%, p95 latency delta < 15ms for paid tiers, error spike < 0.3% sustained 10m, billing-delta deviation < 15% token-cost.
igor: Edge cases: webhooks and third-party side-effects must be exact-once. Orch will carry idempotency keys until we validate. Also make sure we don't change webhook payload ordering that customers rely on.
ops-bot: ci: job "surface-curation-smoke" queued. Tests: unit, integration(12m), semantic-sanity.
lina: Dev ergonomics: need a local docker-compose that runs orch+core+lite-cache and a script to populate cache snapshots for a tenant. This helps reproduce cache-affinity issues.
maya: Tech-debt paydown policy: mark deprecated endpoints in docs, archive transforms after 90d of no traffic and a changelog entry. We'll add a migration-telemetry tag to track adoption.
igor: Action items:
- Lina: cache ownership spec + local dev profile (ETA 4d)
- Maya: telemetry splice list + sign-off metrics (ETA 3d)
- Ops: canary infra + alerting card in console (ETA 5d)
- Product: billing delta UI + opt-out flag (ETA 6d)
We'll reconvene in 72h to review specs and CI run results. :calendar:
